subject: a caterpillar made from three rounded velvet cubes
pose: front cube lifted and rear cube curled upward
art_direction: 三枚不标点数的丝绒立方体连成短毛虫，最后一节翘起，奶绿与莓红触感对比诙谐。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Make a short caterpillar from three rounded velvet cubes, with no dice numbers or symbols on their faces. The front cube lifts slightly and carries two small embroidered eyes with a sleepy amused look; the rear cube curls upward, creating a compact zigzag silhouette. Use pale sage velvet for the head, deep berry for the middle, and warm cream for the tail. Tiny fabric feet sit close beneath the body. Render the changing velvet nap and soft seam compression rather than glossy toy plastic. Set the character against a dark slate-green background under broad studio light. Keep all three cubes inside the circular avatar area, with no props or text.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
